description:
Autoliv's primary goal is to Save More Lives. Our products never get a second chance. This is why we can never compromise on quality. We are working to increase vehicle safety by developing seatbelts, airbags and steering wheels and you can be part of our team as Global Information Security Governance, Risk & Compliance Advanced Analyst.

Are you passionate about using your technical and GRC expertise to shape controls that guide behavior, simplify decisions, and help the organization implement effective security controls where it matters most?

In this role you will be part of the Compliance & Reporting team, responsible for enhance, strengthen, and accelerate the internal information and cybersecurity compliance across the organization. You will actively support, drive, and promote adherence, maturity, and continuous improvement of our information security compliance landscape in ensuring compliance with TISAX, SOX IT General Controls, and internal control frameworks, while helping evolve how controls are designed, implemented, tested, and adopted globally.

This is a hands-on, value‑driven role where you help turn requirements into efficient, effective, and scalable controls—with the ultimate goal of enabling a more secure environment at speed

Should you be interested in overseeing these tasks and aiming for enhanced performance standards, your role will involve:

  • Drive and support global Information & Cyber Security compliance activities, promoting adherence to TISAX, SOX ITGC, and the internal compliance controls based on risk

  • Conduct internal compliance control testing, including design effectiveness, operating effectiveness, and evidence validation

  • Monitor, follow up, and support timely closure of findings, deficiencies, and observations

  • Strengthen control effectiveness by challenging, refining, and simplifying controls to ensure they are risk‑based and efficient

  • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of the global control catalog and its implementation in the GRC tool

  • Act as a trusted compliance advisor, supporting audits with structured evidence and clear communication

  • Guide and enable stakeholders through hands‑on support, training, and best practices, promoting compliance as a business enabler

What you’ll bring

Your mindset and attitude are as important as your technical experience. We are looking for someone who has:

  • University degree or equivalent in IT/Security/Cyber-Security or similar

  • Information Security, Audit or Compliance experience with 3-5 years, preferably in international environment in manufacturing or similar.

  • Knowledge of one or more of the following frameworks: TISAX, ISO 27000, NIST, IEC62443, SOX, COBIT, COSO, ITIL

  • Experience working in GRC tool, preferably ServiceNow is a bonus.

  • Ability to have a structured approach, prioritize and coordinate tasks and manage deadlines

  • Adaptability and embracing changes

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex topics clearly.

  • A collaborative, team‑oriented mindset.

  • A desire to develop knowledge and skills in cybersecurity and stay up to date with emerging trends


We will be more than glad to chat with you about your experience and your career goals.

In our international work setting, you will find a range of opportunities that are designed to enhance your career and personal development. Including new and different perspectives is part of what ensures the team’s success. We are committed to developing people’s skills, knowledge and creative potential. Our training and development programs emphasize technical competency, leadership development and business management skills.

More lives saved – more life lived!
